name: Himalaya Small Infra+
description: The Harvia Himalaya Infra+ sauna cabin has the perfect balance of relaxation and therapeutic benefits. Designed for comfort, efficiency, and ultimate wellness, this sauna is ideal for up to 5 people and offers a range of features that make it the perfect addition to your home or wellness center.

With its ESG glass door and clear glass elements, this sauna is designed for both function and style. It comes with easy-to-follow assembly instructions and all the necessary materials. The Harvia Himalaya Infra+ sauna is also available as a custom build for personalized solutions.

Relax, rejuvenate, and enjoy the numerous health benefits of a Salt Sauna – from improving circulation to reducing inflammation and promoting skin healing. The Harvia Himalaya Infra+ Sauna is your path to a healthier, more balanced lifestyle.
highlights: Cabin made of solid spruce for durability and a natural look
Effective Infrared Heating: Includes a 350W full-spectrum infrared heater (with wooden backrest) to provide a soothing, deep-penetrating heat that enhances relaxation and promotes healing.

Salt Therapy Benefits: The sauna’s combination of salt bricks and gentle heat activates the hygroscopic properties of salt, releasing valuable minerals into the air, enhancing your breathing, skin health, and overall well-being.
Innovative Lighting: Enhance your sauna experience with the built-in RGBW color-changing lights, easily controlled via a 4-zone remote for a fully customizable ambiance.
Luxurious Interior: The interior features Lindenwood benches (620 mm), headrests, backrests, ventilation sliders, and a bank sight cover, all designed for maximum comfort during your sauna sessions.

name: Sauna cabin Variant 1150x1150
description: The basic layout of the Harvia Variant sauna is ample and provides you with the opportunity for a variety of different arrangements. The Variant sauna is also the most flexible of Harvia’s sauna designs: you have four options (spruce, aspen, alder and heat-treated aspen) for wall and ceiling paneling, and you can choose the windows and the tone of the doors that best match your personal taste. You can choose the interior design of your Variant sauna from Harvia’s two stylish alternatives: Formula or Exclusive Air. A Variant sauna is completely insulated and, therefore, very energy efficient. Metallic corner pieces on the corners of the fascia board give your sauna a distinctive look. In Harvia Variant sauna you find the cozy, relaxed atmosphere of the original Finnish sauna. The benches and sauna interior are ergonomically designed and follow original Finnish sauna traditions. High-quality bench design guarantee your enjoyment.

name: Block Right Medium
description: Step into a sauna where light and structure define the atmosphere. Harvia Block Right Medium brings clean geometry, refined materials and authentic Finnish heat into contemporary interiors.

The silk-printed tempered safety glass front allows natural light to enter while maintaining safety and a composed architectural look. The black framing gives the cabin a clear, modern expression that integrates naturally into modern homes.

Interior and exterior surfaces are finished in brushed thermo alder. Through thermal modification, the wood gains enhanced stability and a naturally rich tone, creating a material that looks refined and performs reliably in sauna conditions. The L-shaped benches combine a sturdy spruce frame with smooth aspen seating boards that remain comfortable even at higher temperatures. All visible wood surfaces are knotless premium quality.

The structure is insulated with a high-performance 30 mm PIR insulation board, engineered to support efficient heat retention in a slim wall construction. This enables quick heat-up and stable warmth throughout the session.

The cabin is delivered as a carefully engineered element structure. With only a limited number of precision-built wall elements and hidden fittings, installation is efficient and clean. Adjustable legs allow fine alignment on slightly uneven floors, and each cabin is test-assembled in Finland before delivery to ensure accuracy.
Each Block cabin is designed and built in Finland to guarantee structural precision and long-term durability.

Choose between a traditional Finnish heater, a pillar model with generous stone capacity or a combi version for adjustable humidity. The Fenix touch control panel enables intuitive operation, and MyHarvia compatibility allows convenient remote control.
Block Medium is a modern sauna defined by clarity, material quality and authentic heat.

name: Block Right Large
description: Harvia Block Right Large creates a bright and structured sauna environment where architecture and warmth meet. The balanced proportions and open glass front establish a calm and refined atmosphere.

The silk-printed tempered safety glass façade brings natural light into the cabin while reinforcing its architectural presence. Optional glass corner elements can further enhance the sense of openness.

Both the interior and exterior surfaces are finished in brushed thermo alder, a thermally modified wood known for its stability and warm, refined tone. The L-shaped benches are built with a durable spruce frame and topped with smooth aspen seating boards that remain comfortable even as temperatures rise.

The cabin structure incorporates a 30 mm high-performance PIR insulation board, designed to deliver strong thermal efficiency in a compact construction. The result is faster heat-up and reliable temperature stability.

Block is built as a precision element cabin with hidden fittings and pre-planned cable routing. The construction supports a controlled and efficient installation process, whether carried out independently or with the support of a Harvia reseller. Adjustable base legs help ensure accurate positioning.
Every Block sauna is designed and built in Finland, handcrafted and test-assembled to guarantee safety and precision.

Heating can be tailored to your preference with traditional electric, pillar or combi heater options. The Fenix touch display provides clear control, and MyHarvia integration enables flexible remote operation.
Block Large combines architectural restraint with dependable Finnish sauna expertise.

Harvian Fenix prefabricated saunas are equipped with a large, impressive glass wall. With the optional RGBW LED lights, you can easily create a different atmosphere in the sauna.

name: Utu Mini

name: Ventura Large
description: Harvia Ventura Large elevates sauna design into a statement of movement and material. The curved benches and backrests are formed from molded ash veneer, flowing together in a continuous and harmonious shape.

Ash veneer combines elegance with durability. It maintains its light tone over time and performs reliably in heat and humidity. The shaped front edges improve seating comfort while highlighting the clean and balanced design of the interior.
The full glass front enhances the sense of openness and allows natural light to define the interior atmosphere. Black spruce exterior panels create a bold architectural contrast.
A 30 mm PIR insulation structure supports efficient heat retention and consistent performance. The cabin’s element-based construction with hidden fittings ensures precision and visual purity.
The Harvia Spirit heater is a natural design companion to Ventura, echoing the curved interior and delivering smooth, enveloping steam through its generous stone mass.

Alternative heater options are also available, from traditional electric models to pillar heaters with increased stone capacity or combi versions for added humidity. The Fenix touch display ensures intuitive control, and MyHarvia compatibility allows convenient remote management.

Ventura Large is constructed as a robust element-based sauna, engineered for structural stability and precise assembly. The limited number of carefully manufactured wall elements and hidden attachments preserve the clean visual expression of the design.

Fine adjustment is supported by integrated adjustable base legs, ensuring accurate alignment during installation. Every Ventura sauna is designed and built in Finland, and each unit is test-assembled prior to delivery to guarantee precision, safety and lasting quality.
Ventura Large is a design-forward sauna where form, material and authentic Finnish heat are in harmony.
